searchText: So far, the only other client that has enabled eth/69 on the default branch is nimbus However, it appears Nimbus does not validate received BlockRangeUpdate. My test sends an invalid announcement with earliest > latest and expects a disconnect, but Nimbus just keeps the connection open <@&595681804422479873> ^^ https://hivetests2.ethdevops.io/suite.html?suiteid=1747568995-c5cb8c9886dce0c681fb730ccfe8c348.json&suitename=eth#test-29 Looking into this tomorrow Indeed it hasn’t been tested well I've also been wondering if we should require checking the blockhash against existing history Like, if a node sends a BlockHashUpdate where the hash is a known block with a different number than the announced one It's a weird corner case though depends on finalization status, no? No I mean something else. The validation should NOT check that the announced block number corresponds with the hash, otherwise we will split the network on a chain split, which is not good. But we could check that the hash matches the number, if we know the block.
